name: Trim Prime Initial Prep — Template (Pre-Primer)
intent: Pre-primer trim prep — dust/wipe, fill end grain, sand bare. NO caulk in this phase (caulk does not bond to bare wood); main caulk_joints fires post-prime in the matching MOD_PREP_<substrate>_PAINT module. Extended by per-substrate MOD_PREP_<substrate>_PRIME_INITIAL modules.
doctrine: Default height:true matches the majority of trim substrates. Floor-adjacent substrates (baseboard, shoe mold, chair rail, wainscot cap) and door-frame/casing override height:false. Mirrors the height-default choice in MOD_TEMPLATE_TRIM_PAINT.
